correctness.rationale: At each stage k the allowed vacancy pairs are exactly k²−e; the marked-pair hazard is an exact ratio. Summable O_Δ(k^-2) comparison with a single missing edge gives pair survival K(K+1)/[n(n+1)](1+O_Δ(1/K)). Joint marked-set survival controls other forbidden pairs conditional on the marked pair with error O_Δ(K/n+mK²/n²). The missing-biclique counting argument bounds terminals with ≥2 pairs by O_Δ(n^-3). Taking K=floor(n^(1/3)) proves the stated uniform relative error; 31 exact computations passed independently.

value.rationale: An otherwise perfectly matchable dense bipartite substrate can suffer irreversible rare jamming. This gives an asymptotically sharp reliability coefficient across every fixed bounded-degree defect arrangement, including overlapping defects without exchangeability, rather than a near-trivial occupancy fraction approaching one. It subsumes one symmetric toy case but establishes nontrivial structural universality.
